name: ant-farm
description: Mission control for your subagents: what each one is doing, its activity and its cost, live.

budgetUsd.title: Session budget (USD)
budgetUsd.description: Off (0) unless you set one. When the session's estimated spend (Claude Code's own estimate, else the price-table estimate) reaches this, ant-farm shows a toast and turns its budget mark amber; past twice it, red. It only warns: it never stops Claude.
